input: CLAIM: Region X has the country's highest rate of incidents involving unaccompanied minors. || SOURCES: [1] The national statistics bureau's official published incident table, dated 2025.

CLAIM: Vendor Q plans to shut down its bulk-data endpoint. || SOURCES: [1] Newspaper A, bylined article, 2026-05, original reporting from its own named sources. [2] Newspaper B, bylined article, 2026-05, original reporting from different named sources. Neither article cites the other or any common document.

CLAIM: The library's license forbids commercial hosting. || SOURCES: [1] Tech site A's article (2026-01). [2] Tech site B's article (2026-02), which links to and quotes site A's article as its source.

CLAIM: Framework Y is losing all its maintainers. || SOURCES: [1] Blog A citing a post on blog Z. [2] News-styled site B citing the same blog Z post. [3] Aggregator C citing the same blog Z post. The blog Z post is bylined and dated 2026-02, and cites nothing further.
CLAIM: The dog-grooming software market is saturated. || SOURCES: [1] A screenshot of a search engine's AI answer box making this statement. No other sources.
CLAIM: Paid newsletters are dead as a business model. || SOURCES: [1] An undated, unbylined page on an SEO content site. [2] Another undated aggregator listicle repeating the sentence.

CLAIM: The startup laid off half its engineering team. || SOURCES: [1] One bylined newspaper article, dated 2026-07, based on the reporter's own interviews. No filings, statements, or other coverage exist in the dossier.
CLAIM: The compression algorithm reduces genomic data size by 40% versus the previous standard. || SOURCES: [1] A peer-reviewed paper in an established journal, 2025, reporting the benchmark.

CLAIM: Company M was fined by the securities regulator last year. || SOURCES: [1] Three aggregator sites repeat the claim. The regulator publishes all enforcement actions in a searchable public database; the database contains no record involving company M.
CLAIM: Language runtime N will remove its garbage collector next year. || SOURCES: [1] A pasted chatbot conversation in which the chatbot asserts this. No other sources.

CLAIM: Version 3.2 of the proxy has an unauthenticated remote-code-execution vulnerability. || SOURCES: [1] The CVE entry in the official vulnerability database, published 2026-07, listing affected version 3.2.
CLAIM: Vendor R charges $0.02 per API request. || SOURCES: [1] Vendor R's own published pricing page, current as of 2026-09.
CLAIM: Platform Y prohibits automated marketing posts. || SOURCES: [1] Platform Y's official developer policy page, updated 2026-04. [2] An undated SEO listicle also mentioning it.

CLAIM: The database engine corrupts data under concurrent writes. || SOURCES: [1] Blog post A (bylined, 2026-03) reproducing the corruption with its own test harness and steps. [2] Blog post B by an unrelated author (bylined, 2026-04) reproducing it independently on different hardware. The two posts use different reproductions and do not cite each other or any common upstream; the project's maintainers have not commented.
